IGUI_MVM_ConfirmImportMVCK:
Import every Mysterious Vehicle Claim Key claim into this mod?
Loaded vehicles move over now; the rest move over the next time they load.
MVCK data is not deleted. You can run this again to pick up new claims. Remove MVCK from the server once you are happy.

IGUI_MVM_ConfirmImportIdentity:
Import every whitelisted account with its SteamID?
Afterwards a player only counts as an account when their Steam account matches it, so renaming or split-screen cannot borrow someone else's account. Until the first import, account names are trusted as before.
Accounts whose SteamID changed are listed as conflicts and stay unchanged until you confirm.

%2
Use this when a player moved to another Steam account. The old Steam account loses these accounts.
